issues.description: Method PersonResource.getAllPersons has different access modifiers across artifacts. In TEMPLATE_REPOSITORY/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/rest/PersonResource.java the handler is declared public (signature at line 28). In SOLUTION_REPOSITORY/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/rest/PersonResource.java the same handler is declared private (signature at line 28). This divergence is likely to confuse students about the expected visibility of Spring REST controller handler methods and about which visibility to follow when implementing or testing controllers.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent between template and solution. Prefer declaring the controller handler method as public to match the template and common expectations for Spring MVC handlers: change the solution's method signature to 'public ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons(...)'. If the private visibility is intentional, update the template and problem statement to document and justify the non-public handler usage.
